shots.camera: low rear three-quarter chase on the bridge deck, hero filling the lower third
shots.description: Mateo drives the orange Scarlet Arrow (plate SUN-8821) east along the Sunset Bay Bridge causeway, sea on both sides of the railings, two Bay City PD patrol cars glued to his bumper, a roadblock under the SUNSET BAY BRIDGE gantry sign ahead, the police helicopter low over the water, deck lamps and pillars down to the waves, and a full HUD: four wanted stars, $15,300, mission panel M2 THREE GATES stage 3/3 with timer, dispatch board, minimap and health/armour/respect bars.
shots.title: Bridge chase over the sea

shots.camera: close front three-quarter, Mateo large in frame, crowd all around
shots.description: Mateo Vega on foot in the Little Havana day market, close to camera: burnt-orange bomber jacket, white tee, face and stubble readable, shoppers pressing in around him in the aisle between the two striped-stall rows, vendors behind the counters, paper lanterns and lit JUICE / FLOWERS / GRILL signs overhead, the yellow mission beacon burning at the far end and the police helicopter low over the stalls. Bright cloudy day, HUD shows two wanted stars and M3 MARKET DAY stage 1/3.
shots.title: Market walk in Little Havana

shots.camera: low rear three-quarter chase in the container lane, hero filling the lower third
shots.description: Sunset chase on the Sunset Harbor container quay: the Scarlet Arrow threads the lane between two walls of stacked colourful containers, two Bay City PD patrol cars flanking ahead, a roadblock ahead, the yellow PORT SUNSET gantry crane overhead with a container on its hook, a forklift and hi-vis dock workers at the lane edges, the helicopter over the quay, the sun setting over the water behind the roadblock, and the HUD shows four wanted stars and M2 THREE GATES stage 3/3.
shots.title: Harbor chase at sunset

shots.camera: low view from the south sand, hero car and Mateo left of the title text, city behind
shots.description: The PIER HEAT — Sunset Bay title screen from the beach at sunset: Mateo stands beside the orange Scarlet Arrow parked on the sand, waves and foam at the waterline, umbrellas, surfboards and beachgoers in the foreground, the city skyline and a patrol car behind, the police helicopter high over the bay. Start Engine button, controls list, and the real Slot 1 save: M2 PIER RUN, $15,300, Respect 140.
shots.title: Title screen from the beach
